newsitem.title: USA: Worldwide Leisure names Pappas chairman.
newsitem.headline: Worldwide Leisure names Pappas chairman.

text.p: Worldwide Leisure Corp, formerly Majestic Development and Management Corp, said Tuesday it elected George Pappas of New York as chairman of the board and chief executive officer.
Pappas succeeds Jack Deming, who left the company to pursue other interests.

Worldwide Leisure said Pappas, who has had entrepreneurial experience in global capital markets and headed various corporations, will lead the company's planned programs of expansion through acquisitions of multi-industry properties in the United States and abroad.
Initial acquisitions will be made in the area of casino destination resorts and wellness providers and facilities. The company expects announcements to be made within the next 30 days.
